from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    coords=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3 and 0<r<len(grid)-1 and 0<c<len(row)-1 and (r==3 or r==len(grid)-4 or c==3 or c==len(row)-4)]
    # Fill the framed area in alternating square bands, retaining the interior marker.
    r0=min(r for r,c in coords); r1=max(r for r,c in coords); c0=min(c for r,c in coords); c1=max(c for r,c in coords)
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            out[r][c]=4
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if grid[r][c]==3]
    if marks:
        mr,mc=marks[0]
        # Nested square rings centered on the marker, alternating colors.
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                d=max(abs(r-mr),abs(c-mc))
                if d>0 and d%2==0: out[r][c]=2
        out[mr][mc]=3
    return out
'''
